purpose: Explain who may find a private capital relationship relevant, how the public-to-private doorway works, and the controls that apply before any investment-specific material is supplied.
audience: selected strategic co-investors or professional lenders where appropriate
trusted direct introducers and professional advisers who know a potentially relevant principal

useful: professional website or reference where appropriate

private_process: appropriate lawful communication basis and recipient classification
controlled diligence, KYC/AML, approvals and definitive documentation
possible_private_instrument_families: private Loan Note or comparable instrument
instrument_boundary: No instrument is represented by the public gateway as final, approved, available, allocated or offered.
public_firewall: no public coupon, target return, minimum subscription, allocation or application form
no invest-now, subscribe, reserve-notes or retail investment funnel
no downloadable private investment memorandum or term sheet from the public website
no adviser, bank, trustee, exchange or regulator endorsement by implication
future platform scale is not present collateral
unresolved Sun Park recovery, damages and fruits are not current cash, recognised NAV or ordinary Montaña Roja debt-service support
Montaña Roja must stand on its own transaction, planning, technical, economic and financing merits
specific financing remains subject to legal, regulatory, tax, diligence, KYC/AML, approval and definitive-document requirements
material_status_rule: Historical or superseded financing drafts are not current offers and must not be used as present terms. Any current private material must state its own date, status, recipient boundary and reliance limitations.
relationship_architecture: Sun Rock hospitality and investment platform
repository_rule: Public Git contains only public-safe architecture. Detailed family balance-sheet information, transaction-specific terms, private memoranda and eligibility decisions remain restricted.
gitlab_rule: GitLab remains read-only from the originating GitHub workspace. The separate GitLab congestion workspace must reconcile this release into then-current canonical GitLab before declaring the Sun Rock dependency complete.
group_platform_legal_status: Sun Rock is the commercial hospitality and investment group/platform identity; it is not presented as a separate incorporated parent company, issuer or automatic borrower.
project_structure: Individual ring-fenced hotel ProjectCos with transaction-specific legal borrowers/issuers, equity, debt, accounts, security and underwriting.
terminology_rule: Rights, financing obligations and security attach to the actual legal entity and documents. The Sun Rock brand/platform does not itself create recourse to Aweswell or other ProjectCos.

active_project_public_status.meaning: Owner-authorised strategic pursuit, transaction diligence and financing preparation; no acquisition, accepted seller price, signed definitive SPA, planning permission, operator appointment, financing commitment, lender endorsement or construction start is represented.
